blurb:
Combat Zone Paintball offers an exhilarating paintball rental experience in Las Vegas, perfect for groups of friends or family. Choose from three types of play: Standard Impact (ages 10+), Lower/Medium Impact (ages 8+), and Gel Blaster Surge (ages 5+). Enjoy a shaded staging area with picnic tables, lights for night play, and cooling misters (during warmer months), allowing for a comfortable adventure. Paintball rentals include admission, 500 rounds of ammo, Paintball gun/maker, Paintball mask, hopper, and tank, (females rental includes chest protection), use of our 3 different Paintball fields, ensuring a complete package for your day of fun. 

Gel Blaster Surge rental includes admission, Gel gun, Paintball mask, 1,600 rounds of gel ammo, and use of 4 different fields.

- Flexible play options for all skill levels and ages 5 and up
- Affordable rental packages starting at $30, including all essential gear

- Convenient location. Reservations Required.
